title: USSD language and location onboarding
text: New USSD callers dial *801# and choose 1 for Ikinyarwanda or 2 for English, then select their sector and cell. Returning callers retain their location and language. Use main-menu option 0 to change language. Reporting options 1–6 retain their meanings. Simulator identities are isolated from real participants. Kinyarwanda wording requires native-speaker approval; automated tests do not establish carrier acceptance.

title: Rainfall reporting and missing observations
text: USSD option 3 records rainfall in millimetres (mm). The existing application accepts readings from 0 to 300 mm; this is an application rule, not an approved local climatological threshold. SMS uses IMVURA followed by the reading. Rainfall summaries use dated observations and daily gauge aggregation. Rejected reports are excluded; the latest reading is used for repeated gauge/day observations. Missing rainfall remains missing, not zero. Demonstration and simulator records are not field evidence.

title: Scientific report verification and corrections
text: Authorized staff review report quality, units, observation dates, provenance and verification status. Scientific yield comparison requires measured harvested area, comparable crop/season/year observations and sourced approved targets. Corrections retain original reports and link replacements; do not silently overwrite evidence. Demonstration, simulator, rejected and superseded records are excluded from eligible evidence. Without approved references or sufficient observations, outputs remain unverified or not computable. Do not invent PADAB or APEFA baseline values.

title: SMS delivery reconciliation and unknown outcomes
text: Provider acceptance is distinct from confirmed delivery. Delivery operations masks recipient numbers and journals authenticated receipts. Unknown outcomes require provider evidence before retry. An operator must confirm that nothing was sent before requeueing an uncertain delivery; do not resend blindly. SMS and airtime stay in dry-run until credentials, callbacks and telecom acceptance are approved. The assistant cannot send messages, pay airtime or change delivery records.

title: Privacy, grievances and access
text: Protected records follow staff roles and sector scopes. Grievance records omit the reporter link; restricted roles receive masked personal details. Retention is minimization/pseudonymization, not a promise that every linkage is irrecoverable. Retention apply requires an approved policy reference and explicit database confirmation. Never put participant phone numbers, confidential grievance text, credentials or personal documents into the document assistant.

title: Staging readiness and deployment approval
text: Use an isolated staging database, approved test identities and dry-run providers. Build the frontend and container, back up the intended database and apply migrations before startup. Verify /health for process liveness and /ready for database readiness. Require sign-in and exact CORS origins. Check simulator onboarding, returning callers, role scopes and evidence exclusions. Production deployment, DNS, billing and live messages require separate approval. Automated tests do not authorize pilot or institutional activation.
